description: Review state of a plan: status, verdicts with notes, open comment threads anchored to plan lines, reviewer suggestions, budget approval, and the model/cost view with Lake's cost-cutting suggestion ids. Works locally before a PR exists. Set wait_seconds to wait for a decision or new feedback. Also syncs approvals so the lake-gate hook opens once approved.

plan_id.description: Plan id (defaults to the active plan)

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long for a change (polls every 20s)

name: lake_review_status
